hypothesis: Complete legal source units plus immediate same-paragraph context improve evidence use compared with arbitrary overlapping fixed-token windows.
query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

source_partition.paragraph_boundary: blank-line break, including its exact whitespace
source_partition.atom_boundary: sentence or semicolon followed by whitespace
source_partition.oversize_policy: Explicit observed NLI token-offset fallback, complete source retained

ranking_depth_scope: min(40, total_units) anchor candidates for native, lexical and positional arms; same-paragraph neighbor expansion may inspect additional units under the same512-token budget
packing: Scan ranked anchors; add complete anchor if it fits, then previous and next same-paragraph units if they fit; concatenate merged selected spans in source order
decoder: Unchanged pinned candidate4 DeBERTa-base singleton, no padding, no truncation
legacy_arm_names: ruvector_top2/same_nli_lexical_top2/same_nli_positional_first2 are interface aliases; epoch6 ranks up to40 anchor candidates, may inspect same-paragraph neighbors outside that ranking, and packs a variable number identically under512 tokens
